description: The Nobel Prize API's physics laureates, read as a table in Polars (one row per prize; John Bardeen has two), counted per decade and by country of birth. Statistics: a trend with an uncertainty band. The mean age at the award stayed near 50 until the 1960s and passed 70 in the 2020s; the band is the 95% interval of each decade's mean, and the ages' own spread is far wider. Caveats: age is award year minus birth year (within a year), a decade holds only 7 to 28 laureates (the 2020s are not over), and a rising age may reflect a longer wait between discovery and prize rather than older discoverers. Hover a dot for the laureate; click it for Wikipedia.
name: Nobel Prize in Physics
